canonical_data: a SQLite fact graph per project holding facts, intents, hints, claims, heartbeats, and reason leases, served by the dispatcher API
strengths: The dispatcher owns scheduling and persistence beyond worker sessions: projects, the fact and intent graph, claims, heartbeats, and reason leases live in SQLite and are read back for every scheduling decision
Workers have no fixed roles; Bootstrap, Reason, and Explore tasks are generated at runtime from the graph state and coordinated stigmergically through the shared board
Supervision is explicit: per-task timeouts, worker health checks, heartbeat leases, and a two-phase conclude fallback that releases intents on failure
Container-per-project execution by default with a documented local mode, and three worker backends behind one adapter registry
weaknesses: Intended only for environments with explicit authorization to operate: the shipped worker image is a Kali container for CTF work and workers are invoked with permissions bypassed, and the catalog carries it only with that disclaimer
The only validation presented is one self-reported AI pentesting competition result with postmortem links; no non-pentest domain validation exists despite the general-purpose claim
Local mode runs workers with the user's permissions and no sandbox, which the example configuration itself warns about
The README glosses the licence as AGPLv3 for personal and educational use with a commercial-license offer, which the AGPL text alone does not say; no commercial terms document was reviewed
why_it_matters: A stigmergic multi-worker agent engine: a shared fact board with runtime-generated tasks instead of fixed roles, validated first on autonomous penetration testing.
